use stucco::{Bundle, theme::Preset};

let bundle = Bundle::new(Preset::Pine);

use stucco::theme::{Color, Density, Fonts, Radius, Theme, TypeScale};

let theme = Theme::from_seed(160.0) // accent hue in OKLCH degrees
    .accent(Color::oklch(0.6, 0.14, 160.0))
    .neutral_hue(150.0)
    .neutral_tint(0.012)
    .fonts(Fonts::system().sans("Inter"))
    .type_scale(TypeScale::new(16.0, 1.25))
    .radius(Radius::Round)
    .density(Density::Compact);
let built = theme.build()?; // fails with a report if any pair misses its contrast target

use stucco::theme::{Finish, Preset, Theme};

let theme = Theme::preset(Preset::Sand).finish(Finish::Float);

analysis.summary: Stucco 0.3.0 provides themed server rendering, native display and status components, optional Axum integration, typed collections, and form workflows. These focused recipes use the frozen 0.3.0 evidence; consult each recorded compilation result and feature selection. Storage integration and browser enhancement still require application code beyond these examples.

findings.title: Select features from the 0.3.0 manifest
findings.guidance: Use Rust 1.85 or later. Default features include overlay; axum, collections, derive, and icons require explicit selection. derive enables collections and its component dependencies. For migration from 0.2, remove the reserved marketing/diagram/markdown/askama/maud features and use into_http for plain HTTP response conversion.

findings.title: Deliver assets with rendered HTML
findings.guidance: Compose a Bundle and Page, using main for a landmark and skip link or app for an AppShell. Default output references assets under /_stucco/: serve the bundle or export its files alongside static pages. Delivery::Inline embeds the required assets for standalone output, but inline pages cannot receive fragments.

findings.title: Finish router construction with stucco
findings.guidance: Add axum 0.8 and Tokio with macros, rt-multi-thread, and net. Call Router::stucco last, after routes and state; handlers take PageCx and return Document. Content renders when assigned, allowing request-local borrows. Use stucco_with and LayerConfig to change the documented 1 MiB body limit and 30-second timeout.

findings.title: Keep fragment responses paired with a full-page fallback
findings.guidance: Build ordinary navigation and forms first. PageCx::respond selects named fragments using Stucco-Request and Stucco-Target headers and falls back to the full page for other targets. Browser request and swapping logic is still needed. Use Page::enhanced when a page must receive fragments before any component behavior has loaded the runtime.

findings.title: Match table controls to backend capabilities
findings.guidance: Use collections for typed tables; add derive when columns should come from a struct. Reuse column_specs for query parsing. Controls require both column declarations and backend capabilities; marking a column does not implement querying. Cursor totals may be unknown, filtering can scan many records, and the example's numbered mode scans all matches. Scope queries to the requester independently of cursor validation.

findings.title: Preserve values and explain validation failures
findings.guidance: Validate FormState with Validator and finish into a typed value. On failure, bind the returned state to fields, map ErrorSummary entries to control IDs, and return 422 from HTTP handlers. On success, use a 303 redirect. Preserve submitted values and reinsert the issued CSRF token when rendering errors; passwords are not redisplayed.

findings.title: Configure CSRF and flash layers explicitly
findings.guidance: Install CsrfLayer and FlashLayer explicitly before the final stucco call; enabling axum alone does not install them. Configure the browser-visible origin and a stable secret key. Include the issued token on unsafe requests. Keep secure cookies in production and align CSRF buffering with request body limits. Flash cookies are signed, readable, short-lived feedback, not authorization or secret storage.

findings.title: Keep conflict recovery and return navigation explicit
findings.guidance: Compare revisions and save atomically in storage; with_conflict only records UI state. Return 409 while retaining submitted values and the submitted revision. If ErrorSummary and ConflictNotice are both shown, disable focus on the notice. Revalidate ReturnContext on each request with application-owned allowlists; it prevents external return redirects but does not authorize access or validate filter values.

findings.title: Validate themes and choose scheme ownership
findings.guidance: Use presets or seeded themes for reproducible appearance within this release. Handle custom-theme contrast failures with Theme::build or Bundle::try_new instead of relying on Bundle::new's panic. Seed mappings may change in minor releases. Use server_theme for a server-owned scheme preference; it omits the localStorage initializer but does not disable component scripts. Custom CSS should use semantic tokens in stucco.utilities.

findings.title: Preserve rendering and application responsibility boundaries
findings.guidance: Use normal rendering for escaped text and checked URLs; reserve Raw::trusted for trusted markup. Use component builders instead of overriding reserved attributes. For dialogs that must work without script, provide link_opener with a real fallback page. Displayed readiness checks do not grant permission: recheck eligibility and authorization when executing actions.

findings.title: Separate stored values from table presentation
findings.guidance: For money-like values, follow the orders example's separation: retain integer cents in the model, parse decimal input with checked integer arithmetic, and format cells independently. Its floating-point dollars projection supports table filtering; it is not evidence of exact decimal arithmetic for general financial calculations.

findings.title: Compose native status, navigation, progress and disclosures
findings.guidance: Use Badge labels to communicate status independently of tone; mark Avatar decorative only when the same name is adjacent. DescriptionList accepts rich Render values, and Stat changes remain neutral until change_tone is set. Breadcrumbs marks the current page, while Steps uses a zero-based current index. Progress and Meter carry visible labels. Disclosure and Accordion use native details/summary; exclusive accordions depend on browser support. Callout is static content rather than a live announcement. These components live in existing default feature families.

recipes.title: Export a static page with its assets
recipes.description: Write a complete page and its hashed theme assets to an optional output directory (default stucco-example). Assertions check escaped text, the main landmark, the skip link, and exact exported bytes. Serve the output directory at the URL root.

recipes.title: Serve full pages and a named fragment
recipes.description: Exercise full-page, named-fragment, unknown-target fallback, escaping, and stylesheet responses with in-memory requests. Pass --serve to listen on 127.0.0.1:3000 after the checks.

recipes.title: Derive columns and format stored cents
recipes.description: Render table markup from derived columns with separate numeric and display values. This has no backend capabilities or query execution; embed the table in a Page for themed document output.

recipes.title: Render validation errors from returned form state
recipes.description: Demonstrate validation and bound error markup without an HTTP server. A deployed POST flow must supply its handler, CSRF setup and issued token, and a 422 response on validation failure.

recipes.title: Render an inline document with a server-selected scheme
recipes.description: Render a standalone document with an explicit dark scheme and inline assets. This example uses basic elements and no component behaviors; inline output cannot receive fragments.

recipes.title: Render status and details with native components
recipes.description: Render a standalone order page demonstrating all eleven new display, navigation, progress and disclosure components. Replace sample values and navigation URLs with application data and routes.
